Flutter navigation motion formulas and corner geometry are adapted from
compose-miuix-ui/miuix 0.9.4-rc01 (Copyright 2026, compose-miuix-ui contributors):

- miuix-nav: NavDriver.kt, NavSettleEasing.kt, NavTransitions.kt
- miuix-squircle: SquirclePath.kt

Upstream: https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/tree/v0.9.4-rc01
License: Apache License 2.0, included in LICENSE.

The Flutter adaptation uses Flutter's route controller and path renderer.
The Android terminal consumes the published miuix-nav library directly.
